description: This file defines the TaskRepository class, which manages task data operations such as creating, updating, deleting, and observing tasks within a Kotlin Android application. It interacts with a LocalTaskStore to persist data and provides a reactive API using Flows.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing a singleton interface for task data management, including creation, observation, update, deletion, and toggling completion status.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate TaskRepository with a LocalTaskStore backed by SharedPreferences.

methods.name: observeTasks
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting the list of all tasks, sorted by completion status and recency.

methods.name: observeTask
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a single task identified by its id.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Suspending function that adds a new task with a title and description, returning the newly assigned task id.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Suspending function to update task details for a specific task id.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Suspending function to delete a task by its id.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Suspending function to change the completion state of a task.
